visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair stands in a well-lit gym, capturing a full-body reflection in a large wall mirror using her black smartphone. She is dressed in a light grey sports bra and tight-fitting black athletic shorts, paired with off-white sneakers. Behind her, various gym equipment including a weight bench labeled 'VULCAN' and colorful resistance bands hanging on the wall are visible. The floor is covered with black rubber matting, and the room is illuminated by bright fluorescent ceiling lights. (2) The camera cuts to a closer medium shot of the woman posing. She places her left hand on her waist to accentuate her figure while her right hand, holding the phone, is positioned to frame her face and upper torso. Her expression is calm and confident as she looks into the lens via the mirror. She wears a simple white smartwatch on her left wrist. The background details remain consistent with the gym interior, showing metal racks and fitness accessories. (3) The scene transitions to a different area of the gym where a heavy-duty power rack and weight plates are the central background elements. The woman stands in the center of the frame, facing the mirror again, showcasing a slightly wider stance. The lighting here is equally bright, casting soft shadows on her abdominal muscles. She slightly tilts her head to the side, adjusting her long hair that falls over her shoulder. The overall setting is clean and appears to be a professional fitness studio. (4) In the final visual phase, the woman returns to a pose similar to the opening, but with a more dynamic leg positioning, stepping one foot forward. She continues to hold the smartphone steady for the mirror selfie. The surrounding environment remains empty of other gym-goers, emphasizing her as the sole subject. The composition is centered, focusing on her athletic silhouette against the backdrop of functional training equipment and neutral-colored walls.
